5 /-! Every nonvertex target has a flat chart in which the actual cut locus
6 is the Voronoi boundary of finitely many active shortest-route sources. -/
7 
8 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
9 
10 open Set
11 
12 /-- A flat chart with the exact finite nearest-source description of the cut locus. -/
13 structure CutVoronoiChart (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a b : frontier P.body) extends P.FlatChart b where
14   sources : Set Plane
15   finite_sources : sources.Finite
16   source_distance : ∀ p ∈ sources, dist p origin = P.surfaceDist a b
17   route_count : sources.ncard = Nat.card (P.geodesicFiber a b)
18   local_distance : ∀ x ∈ domain,
19     (∀ p ∈ sources, P.surfaceDist a (map x) ≤ dist p x) ∧
20       ∃ p ∈ sources, P.surfaceDist a (map x) = dist p x
21   cut_diagram : ∀ x ∈ domain, map x ∈ P.multipleRouteLocus a ↔ x ∈ voronoiBoundary sources
22   source_routes : ∀ p, p ∈ sources ↔ ∃ f ∈ P.geodesicFiber a b,
23     ∃ start : unitInterval, start < 1 ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc start 1,
24       AffineMap.lineMap p origin (t : ℝ) ∈ domain ∧
25       map (AffineMap.lineMap p origin (t : ℝ)) = (f t : Space)
26   route_stability : ∀ (p : Plane) (f : P.BoundaryCurve), f ∈ P.geodesicFiber a b →
27     (∃ start : unitInterval, start < 1 ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc start 1,
28       AffineMap.lineMap p origin (t : ℝ) ∈ domain ∧
29       map (AffineMap.lineMap p origin (t : ℝ)) = (f t : Space)) →
30     ∃ W : Set P.BoundaryCurve, IsOpen W ∧ f ∈ W ∧
31       ∀ g ∈ W, g ∈ P.geodesicCurves → g 0 = a →
32         ∀ x ∈ domain, map x = (g 1 : Space) → P.surfaceDist a (map x) = dist p x
33 
34 /-- A straight segment eventually stays in any open neighborhood of its endpoint. -/
35 private theorem lineMap_tail_in_open (p z : Plane) {D : Set Plane}
36     (openD : IsOpen D) (zD : z ∈ D) :
37     ∃ start : unitInterval, start < 1 ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc start 1,
38       AffineMap.lineMap p z (t : ℝ) ∈ D := by
39   have continuous : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => AffineMap.lineMap p z t) := by
40     simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module]
41     exact ((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).smul continuous_const).add
42       (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)
43   have open_preimage : IsOpen ((fun t : ℝ => AffineMap.lineMap p z t) ⁻¹' D) :=
44     openD.preimage continuous
45   obtain ⟨ε, positive, interval⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp open_preimage 1 (by simpa using zD)
46   obtain ⟨s, after, before⟩ := exists_between
47     (show max (0 : ℝ) (1 - ε) < 1 from max_lt (by norm_num) (by linarith))
48   refine ⟨⟨s, (le_max_left _ _).trans after.le, before.le⟩, before, ?_⟩
49   intro t ht
50   apply interval
51   change dist (t : ℝ) 1 < ε
52   rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr t.property.2)]
53   have lower : s ≤ (t : ℝ) := ht.1
54   have := (le_max_right (0 : ℝ) (1 - ε)).trans_lt after
55   linarith

59 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
60   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
61     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)

63 include graph small_faces in
64 theorem cut_voronoi_chart_in_face (a b : frontier P.body) (different : a ≠ b)
65     (F : P.Face) (bF : (b : Space) ∈ F.val)
66     (unique : ∀ G : P.Face, (b : Space) ∈ G.val → G = F) : Nonempty (P.CutVoronoiChart a b) := by
67   obtain ⟨V₀, openV₀, bV₀, diagram₀⟩ :=
68     graph.local_voronoi_cut_locus small_faces a b different F unique
69   obtain ⟨W, openW, bW, minimum₀⟩ :=
70     graph.local_minimum_distance small_faces a b different F unique
71   let V := V₀ ∩ W
72   have openV : IsOpen V := openV₀.inter openW
73   have bV : (b : Space) ∈ V := ⟨bV₀, bW⟩
74   have diagram (x : Space) (hx : x ∈ V ∩ F.val) := diagram₀ x ⟨hx.1.1, hx.2⟩
75   have minimum (x : Space) (hx : x ∈ V ∩ F.val) := minimum₀ x ⟨hx.1.2, hx.2⟩
76   obtain ⟨center, inside⟩ := P.solid
77   obtain ⟨facets⟩ := P.exists_normalized_facets inside
78   obtain ⟨O, openO, bO, plane⟩ := facets.single_face_local_plane F bF unique
79   obtain ⟨lift, in_plane, coordinate, inverse, rigid⟩ :=
80     F.exists_rigid_plane_inverse (P.faceCoordinates F) (P.faceCoordinates_rigid F)
81   let D : Set Plane := lift ⁻¹' (V ∩ O)
82   have origin : P.faceCoordinates F b ∈ D := by
83     change lift (P.faceCoordinates F b) ∈ V ∩ O
84     rw [inverse b (subset_affineSpan ℝ _ bF)]
85     exact ⟨bV, bO⟩
86   have in_face (x : Plane) (hx : x ∈ D) : lift x ∈ F.val := by
87     have member : lift x ∈ O ∩ (affineSpan ℝ F.val : Set Space) := ⟨hx.2, in_plane x⟩
88     rw [← plane] at member
89     exact member.2
90   obtain ⟨U, openU, bU, covered⟩ := P.unique_face_neighborhood F unique
91   refine ⟨{
92     domain := D
93     open_domain := (openV.inter openO).preimage lift.continuous_of_finiteDimensional
94     origin := P.faceCoordinates F b
95     origin_mem := origin
96     map := lift
97     continuous := lift.continuous_of_finiteDimensional
98     at_origin := inverse b (subset_affineSpan ℝ _ bF)
99     on_surface := fun x hx => F.subset_frontier (in_face x hx)
100     distance := fun x hx y hy => (P.surfaceDist_eq_dist_in_face F (in_face x hx) (in_face y hy)).trans (rigid x y)
101     covers := ⟨U ∩ (V ∩ O), openU.inter (openV.inter openO), ⟨bU, bV, bO⟩, ?_⟩
102     sources := P.activeSources a b F
103     finite_sources := graph.activeSources_finite small_faces a b different F unique
104     source_distance := fun p hp => (P.activeSource_distance a b F p hp).symm
105     route_count := graph.activeSources_ncard small_faces a b different F unique
106     local_distance := ?_
107     cut_diagram := ?_
108     source_routes := ?_
109     route_stability := ?_ }⟩
110   · intro x hx
111     have xF := (covered x ⟨hx.1.1, hx.2⟩).1
112     refine ⟨P.faceCoordinates F x, ?_, inverse x (subset_affineSpan ℝ _ xF)⟩
113     change lift (P.faceCoordinates F x) ∈ V ∩ O
114     rw [inverse x (subset_affineSpan ℝ _ xF)]
115     exact hx.1.2
116   · intro x hx
117     simpa only [coordinate x] using minimum (lift x) ⟨hx.1, in_face x hx⟩
118   · intro x hx
119     rw [diagram (lift x) ⟨hx.1, in_face x hx⟩, coordinate x]
120   · intro p
121     constructor
122     · rintro ⟨f, hf, s, before, tail⟩
123       have last : f 1 = b := congrArg Prod.snd hf.2
124       obtain ⟨u, ub, near⟩ := lineMap_tail_in_open p (P.faceCoordinates F b)
125         ((openV.inter openO).preimage lift.continuous_of_finiteDimensional) origin
126       refine ⟨f, hf, max s u, max_lt before ub, ?_⟩
127       intro t ht
128       have position := tail t ⟨(le_max_left s u).trans ht.1, ht.2⟩
129       rw [last] at position
130       refine ⟨near t ⟨(le_max_right s u).trans ht.1, ht.2⟩, ?_⟩
131       rw [← position.2, inverse _ (subset_affineSpan ℝ _ position.1)]
132     · rintro ⟨f, hf, s, before, tail⟩
133       have last : f 1 = b := congrArg Prod.snd hf.2
134       refine ⟨f, hf, s, before, ?_⟩
135       intro t ht
136       have position := tail t ht
137       refine ⟨position.2 ▸ in_face _ position.1, ?_⟩
138       rw [last, ← position.2, coordinate]
139   · intro p f hf represented
140     have first : f 0 = a := congrArg Prod.fst hf.2
141     have last : f 1 = b := congrArg Prod.snd hf.2
142     have actual : P.HasTerminalSource f F p := by
143       obtain ⟨s, before, tail⟩ := represented
144       refine ⟨s, before, ?_⟩
145       intro t ht
146       have position := tail t ht
147       refine ⟨position.2 ▸ in_face _ position.1, ?_⟩
148       rw [last, ← position.2, coordinate]
149     obtain ⟨q, _, terminal, W, openW, fW, formula⟩ :=
150       graph.geodesic_branch_distance small_faces f hf.1
151         (by simpa only [first, last] using different) F (by simpa only [last] using unique)
152     have same : q = p := terminal.unique actual
153     refine ⟨W, openW, fW, ?_⟩
154     intro g hg geodesic starts x hx mapped
155     have value := formula g hg geodesic (starts.trans first.symm)
156     rw [starts, same, ← mapped, coordinate] at value
157     exact value

159 include graph small_faces in
160 theorem cut_voronoi_chart_at_edge (a b : frontier P.body) (different : a ≠ b)
161     (F G : P.Face) (shared : P.ShareEdge F G) (target : (b : Space) ∈ F.val ∩ G.val)
162     (not_vertex : (b : Space) ∉ P.vertices) :
163     Nonempty (P.CutVoronoiChart a b) := by
164   obtain ⟨center, inside⟩ := P.solid
165   obtain ⟨facets⟩ := P.exists_normalized_facets inside
166   obtain ⟨chart⟩ := exists_edge_folding facets F G shared
167   obtain ⟨patch⟩ := chart.exists_metric_patch shared target not_vertex
168   obtain ⟨V₀, openV₀, bV₀, contained₀, diagram₀⟩ :=
169     patch.local_voronoi_cut_locus graph small_faces a b different patch.center_mem
170   obtain ⟨W, openW, bW, _, minimum₀⟩ :=
171     patch.local_minimum_distance graph small_faces a b different patch.center_mem
172   let V := V₀ ∩ W
173   have openV : IsOpen V := openV₀.inter openW
174   have bV : (b : Space) ∈ V := ⟨bV₀, bW⟩
175   have contained : V ⊆ patch.domain := fun _ hx => contained₀ hx.1
176   have diagram (x : Space) (hx : x ∈ V ∩ frontier P.body) := diagram₀ x ⟨hx.1.1, hx.2⟩
177   have minimum (x : Space) (hx : x ∈ V ∩ frontier P.body) := minimum₀ x ⟨hx.1.2, hx.2⟩
178   let D := patch.sheet.domain ∩ chart.fold.map ⁻¹' V
179   have origin : chart.unfold b ∈ D := by
180     refine ⟨patch.unfold_mem ⟨patch.center_mem, b.property⟩, ?_⟩
181     change chart.fold.map (chart.unfold b) ∈ V
182     rwa [chart.fold_unfold (Or.inl target.1)]
183   have on_surface (x : Plane) (hx : x ∈ D) : chart.fold.map x ∈ frontier P.body :=
184     patch.sheet.on_surface ⟨x, hx.1, rfl⟩
185   refine ⟨{
186     domain := D
187     open_domain := patch.sheet.open_domain.inter (openV.preimage chart.fold.continuous)
188     origin := chart.unfold b
189     origin_mem := origin
190     map := chart.fold.map
191     continuous := chart.fold.continuous
192     at_origin := chart.fold_unfold (Or.inl target.1)
193     on_surface := on_surface
194     distance := ?_
195     covers := ⟨V, openV, bV, ?_⟩
196     sources := chart.activeSources a b
197     finite_sources := patch.activeSources_finite graph small_faces a b different patch.center_mem
198     source_distance := fun p hp => (chart.activeSource_distance patch a b patch.center_mem p hp).symm
199     route_count := patch.activeSources_ncard graph small_faces a b different patch.center_mem
200     local_distance := ?_
201     cut_diagram := ?_
202     source_routes := ?_
203     route_stability := ?_ }⟩
204   · intro x hx y hy
205     rw [patch.metric _ ⟨contained hx.2, on_surface x hx⟩ _ ⟨contained hy.2, on_surface y hy⟩,
206       EdgeFolding.Neighborhood.unfold_fold chart patch.sheet hx.1,
207       EdgeFolding.Neighborhood.unfold_fold chart patch.sheet hy.1]
208   · intro x hx
209     have xpatch : x ∈ patch.domain ∩ frontier P.body := ⟨contained hx.1, hx.2⟩
210     refine ⟨chart.unfold x, ⟨patch.unfold_mem xpatch, ?_⟩, chart.fold_unfold (patch.on_facets xpatch)⟩
211     change chart.fold.map (chart.unfold x) ∈ V
212     rw [chart.fold_unfold (patch.on_facets xpatch)]
213     exact hx.1
214   · intro x hx
215     simpa only [EdgeFolding.Neighborhood.unfold_fold chart patch.sheet hx.1] using
216       minimum _ ⟨hx.2, on_surface x hx⟩
217   · intro x hx
218     rw [diagram _ ⟨hx.2, on_surface x hx⟩, EdgeFolding.Neighborhood.unfold_fold chart patch.sheet hx.1]
219   · intro p
220     constructor
221     · rintro ⟨f, hf, s, before, tail⟩
222       have last : f 1 = b := congrArg Prod.snd hf.2
223       obtain ⟨u, ub, near⟩ := lineMap_tail_in_open p (chart.unfold b)
224         (patch.sheet.open_domain.inter (openV.preimage chart.fold.continuous)) origin
225       refine ⟨f, hf, max s u, max_lt before ub, ?_⟩
226       intro t ht
227       have position := tail t ⟨(le_max_left s u).trans ht.1, ht.2⟩
228       rw [last] at position
229       refine ⟨near t ⟨(le_max_right s u).trans ht.1, ht.2⟩, ?_⟩
230       rw [← position.2, chart.fold_unfold position.1]
231     · rintro ⟨f, hf, s, before, tail⟩
232       have last : f 1 = b := congrArg Prod.snd hf.2
233       refine ⟨f, hf, s, before, ?_⟩
234       intro t ht
235       have position := tail t ht
236       refine ⟨position.2 ▸ patch.sheet.on_facets position.1.1, ?_⟩
237       rw [last, ← position.2, EdgeFolding.Neighborhood.unfold_fold chart patch.sheet position.1.1]
238   · intro p f hf represented
239     have first : f 0 = a := congrArg Prod.fst hf.2
240     have last : f 1 = b := congrArg Prod.snd hf.2
241     have actual : chart.HasTerminalSource f p := by
242       obtain ⟨s, before, tail⟩ := represented
243       refine ⟨s, before, ?_⟩
244       intro t ht
245       have position := tail t ht
246       refine ⟨position.2 ▸ patch.sheet.on_facets position.1.1, ?_⟩
247       rw [last, ← position.2, EdgeFolding.Neighborhood.unfold_fold chart patch.sheet position.1.1]
248     obtain ⟨q, _, terminal, W, openW, fW, formula⟩ :=
249       patch.geodesic_branch_source graph small_faces f hf.1
250         (by simpa only [first, last] using different) (by simpa only [last] using patch.center_mem)
251     have same : q = p := chart.terminal_source_unique f q p terminal actual
252     refine ⟨W, openW, fW, ?_⟩
253     intro g hg geodesic starts x hx mapped
254     have value := (formula g hg geodesic (starts.trans first.symm)).2
255     rw [starts, same, ← mapped, EdgeFolding.Neighborhood.unfold_fold chart patch.sheet hx.1] at value
256     exact value

258 include graph small_faces in
259 /-- Every nonsource nonvertex point has a flat chart of its actual finite Voronoi diagram. -/
260 theorem cut_voronoi_chart (a b : frontier P.body) (different : a ≠ b)
261     (not_vertex : (b : Space) ∉ P.vertices) :
262     Nonempty (P.CutVoronoiChart a b) := by
263   rcases P.nonvertex_incident_facets b.property not_vertex with
264     ⟨F, target, unique⟩ | ⟨F, G, shared, target, _⟩
265   · exact graph.cut_voronoi_chart_in_face small_faces a b different F target unique
266   · exact graph.cut_voronoi_chart_at_edge small_faces a b different F G shared target not_vertex
267
